title: Restarting previous session
body:
This can probably be immediately deleted, couldn't find the MLE agent forum anywhere.


Is there a way to restart a previous started session? 
Had a glitch with my computer mid session. Couldn't find a way to continue with the previous version without starting a new one

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
The issue concerns memory-related behaviors—specifically, resuming or restoring a previous agent session, which involves memory initialization and content retrieval. This aligns with the "Memory initialization issues" and "Memory content errors" categories in the agent issue taxonomy.
